At least 141 people are killed and dozens are injured during heavy floods and landslides in Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo.
Philippines: The National Disaster Coordinating Council revises the death tolls for Typhoon Reming, with 720 dead, 2,360 injured and 762 missing persons.
